fields.element: METHOD /path (normalize ids to {id}); the thing under test
fields.hypothesis: the class/idea to test on this element
fields.source: where it came from: recon | history | behavior-model | anomaly | derived
fields.budget: cheap | depth — depth is only spent once a signal appears
fields.state: new | in_progress | lead | tested_clean | verified | excluded | needs_B | blocked | duplicate
fields.signal: the anomaly that promoted this to `lead` (null until then)
fields.derived_from: parent item id when this came from another result

notes: EXAMPLE ROW — delete. An OPEN item (new/in_progress/lead) blocks an "exhausted" close via tools/closeout.py.
EXAMPLE ROW — delete. terminal: no signal, closed cheaply.

signal: signed URL minted for a caller-supplied path not owned by caller
notes: EXAMPLE ROW — delete. `lead` = signal seen, depth owed.
EXAMPLE ROW — delete. terminal-but-gap: counts as a NAMED gap in the closeout, not a silent skip.
